source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines the staggered imputation ratio as treated observed total divided by imputed counterfactual total minus one, establishes probability convergence, and says a unit-resampled panel bootstrap can recover standard errors.
Rank-one circuit graphs are exactly simple bipartite even cycles, and alternating log sums vanish on rank-one matrices.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper minimizes variance within its additive design-based estimator class using covariance-dependent coefficients and proves asymptotic normality for a feasible plug-in estimator.

Theorem 3.2 gives EIFs for additive staggered ATT/event-study parameters; the conclusion identifies semiparametric efficiency for nonlinear DiD-type setups as a useful extension.
